name: sofatofu
description: Let your agent keep your CRM up to date. Ask it to find contacts, log calls, and update deals in sofatofu. See what changed and why, and undo most changes.

interface.shortDescription: Let your agent do the CRM work
interface.longDescription:
sofatofu is a CRM built for work you can delegate. Ask your agent to find a contact, log a call, update a deal, or review your pipeline.

See what changed and why, and undo most changes. Your agent works only in the workspace you choose, with the access your role allows.
capabilities: Find records and review your pipeline
Change deal stages and workspace settings

positive.description: Find a company and its open deals
positive.prompt: Find the company Acme in sofatofu and list its open deals.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches companies for Acme, then searches the deals of that company that are not won or lost. Lists each deal with its stage and value, and says when more deals remain.

positive.prompt: Log a call with Dana Lee from today. We agreed to send the pricing proposal next week.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the person Dana Lee, searches for a matching call, then creates one call activity linked to her with a reason. Reports the new activity and its change_id.

positive.description: Move a deal to another stage
positive.prompt: Mark the Acme renewal deal as won.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the deal stages, finds the Acme renewal deal, and sets its stage to won with the read_id of that search and a reason. Reports the change.

positive.description: Explain and undo the last change
positive.prompt: What did you change in sofatofu today? Undo the last change.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the changes of the signed-in user since the start of the day and explains them. Checks that the last change can be reversed, reads the records it changed, and reverses it with a reason. Reports the new change.

positive.prompt: Summarize my open pipeline: how many deals are in each stage, and what is their total value?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the deal stages and the workspace currency, searches the deals that are not won or lost, and reports the count and total value of each stage. Says when the result is partial.

negative.description: Paying an invoice is not supported
negative.prompt: Pay my supplier's invoice of $500 today.
Show me the deals in the sofatofu workspace of another company that I am not a member of.

negative.description: A request that is not CRM work
negative.prompt: Book a flight to Berlin for next Tuesday.

publication.release_notes:
### 📥 Import from another CRM or a spreadsheet

Ask your agent to import companies, people, deals, and activities. The agent skill includes guides for HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, spreadsheets, and CSV files. Your agent uses its own access to the source or an export file. Sofatofu does not connect directly to the source CRM.

A `source_id` on each record lets your agent find it on later runs, add missing records, and update existing records. The skill tells your agent to keep changes made outside the import unless you ask to replace them. Without stable source IDs, a repeat import can create duplicates.

Each batch has its own change in the Ledger. Your agent can undo the import's changes, newest first, where no later changes block undo. It reports any records it cannot undo.

### 🗂️ Keep more record details

- Keep tags and lists in `multi_select` custom fields. Each field holds several option names, and your agent can filter records by an option.
- Store a person's phone number and job title in the built-in `phone` and `job_title` fields.
- Link up to 50 people to one activity, such as the people at a meeting or the recipients of an email.
- Update up to 200 records of one type in one change, with different fields and values for each record. Fields you leave out keep their values.

### 💳 Manage your workspace plan

Workspace owners can subscribe to the Team plan from Workspace settings: $15 per member each month or $150 per member each year. Workspaces get a 14-day trial with no payment card required. Use Manage billing to change the card, view invoices, or cancel.

The sidebar shows how many days remain in the trial, with a View plan link. Members who are not owners can see which owners to ask about the plan. Deleting a workspace cancels its subscriptions without a refund.

### 🔧 Everyday improvements

- Your agent can fix a batch's errors together. A rejected record write lists every failing item from the first failed validation stage or record rule. Later checks can report more problems.
- Your agent can undo a change without reading the affected records first. Later changes still block undo for those records. Undo rule errors list records in a fixed order.
- Deleted records leave the CRM at once and free their email, domain, or source ID for reuse. Change history keeps a copy for 30 days. Your agent can restore a record during that time if no other record holds its unique keys and its linked records still exist.
- Public pages include site and page details for search results and shared link previews. The site footer includes a link to Sofatofu on X.
- Browsers can use a larger, 192-pixel site icon.

### ⚠️ Before you upgrade

- Remove `read_id` from `change reverse` requests, or `--read-id` from the CLI command. Inspect the change's reversibility before you undo it.
- Send `records: [{id, ...values}]` to `record update`, not `ids` and `patch`. In the CLI, use `--records` instead of positional IDs and `--patch`. Each item needs its own `id` and fields to change.
- Use `people` instead of `person` for activity links and filters. Writes take a list of person IDs and replace the whole list. Use `[]` or `null` to clear it.
- Remove `include: "deleted"` from record reads. The `deleted` error is gone. A direct read of a deleted record returns `not_found`. Use change history to find a deletion to undo.
- Read item errors from `errors: [{field, message, items}]`, not the old top-level `index`, `id`, or `items` fields. Item positions start at `0`. Reversal rule errors use record IDs instead of positions.
